prompt:
A pattern extracts a script path from a command string:

  /\.claude\/hooks\/(.+\.cjs)/

It is applied to:

  bash -c 'a=.claude/hooks/one.cjs; b=.claude/hooks/two.cjs; run "$a" "$b"'

Decide whether the captured group equals `one.cjs`.

Verdict convention: answer `pass` if the thing described is sound as it stands, and `fail` if it is defective. The verdict describes the thing under review, never any proposal mentioned about it.
